venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 10/6 (MOD MKZ/JK).** Net sales $1,216 vs target $2,086 (-41.7%). Food $197. Comps $40.65. 38 guests, check avg $32.03. First Bingo with Hennessy in the books; stand-in host as regular bingo host was out of town. Saw several regulars who hadn't been in for a while. Bingo cocktails popular; Sazerac special is split rye and Hennessy. Smooth ending; guests told of other activations. Kitchen: quiet day, look for ways to improve prep. Low napkins. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 10/6 (MOD & Chef MD / JMS).** Net sales $1,878 vs target $1,321 (+42.2%), incl. $900 event sales. Food $24. Comps $21.85 / 1.2% (manager, resident, industry; mostly food for bingo host). 24 guests, check avg $40.74. Solid Tuesday in a slow-tempo week. Soundstripe happy hour group arrived ~4:45 and stayed past 8; Jeremy Parrish of Gallo (sponsoring this month's bingo features) brought reps at ~5:45 for bingo menu and Old Cubans. Bingo started late with lower participation (max three groups at once). Small pop at 10:15; seasonal movies drew a couple of women asking for the film schedule. Low: IPA, Seedlip Agave. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 10/6 (AM MOD Carey + Josh; PM MOD Maggie + Walcott).** Net sales incl. events $22,134 vs target $8,159 (+171.3%). Venue net (ex-events) $8,099 (DC/AM $975, D&C PM $7,124); food incl. events $13,455 (venue food $1,670); event sales $14,035. Comps $306. 215 guests (Tock). Two events: Global Healthcare, 50 guests in Vauxhall 7:30am-5pm (day 1 of 2, all-day breakfast/lunch/snacks), and DaVita, 20 guests, buffet dinner in Garden/6A. Easy Tuesday on the floor, opener and mid server cut before 10:30pm; first trading shift for Hiram Aceves. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 10/6 (MOD Kyler).** Net sales $4,966 vs target $3,700 (+34.2%). Food $342, beverage $4,484, retail $140. Comps $53. 133 guests (SevenRooms), check avg ~$37. Stop-and-go evening that kept the room full; guests wanted to order and check out at the same time, lots of multiple rounds. Waitlist of ~5 parties at 8, only one declined. Four Resy reservations arrived but didn't appear on the host's end; all seated. First solo host night. Top sellers: High Plains Drifter, Paper Wasp, Native Lion, Burner Phone. 1 no-show. Menu count 17/17. Breakage: 1 SOF. No kitchen.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 10/6 (MOD & Chef Julian, Josh, Angel).** Net sales $3,921 vs target $3,693 (+6.2%), all Marquee. Food $881. Comps $103.48. 95 guests, check avg $41.28. Super chill; more walk-ins than reservations, lots of new faces; opened the 20's to fill space. One server on the floor with host support worked well. Some industry guests and birthdays. Kitchen: Angel ran it solo. Maintenance: pests spotted. Low: guava syrup. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 10/6 (MOD Marcus).** Net sales $3,181.89 vs target $3,395 (-6.3%). Marquee bar $3,500.08, food $417.30. Comps $120 (industry $8.14, gift $16, DNL $50, misring $34 not made). 80 guests (64 walk-in, 16 reso), GCA $37.88 (check avg $81.40). Cruisy Tuesday: pop ~7pm, steady to ~9, then dropped; campers at the bar from ~10:30. Teleia on first server training shift. Oyster Tuesday demand strong. Maintenance: curtain, garbage disposal. 86: Roku. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: No rain but overcast and muggy
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 10/6 (AM Sam & Shannon; PM Sam & Drew).** Net sales $3,933 vs target $4,271 (-7.9%). Municipal Bar AM $443 / PM $3,447; Sun Club $43; Hot Eye $0. Food $1,698. Comps $123. 146 guests (OpenTable 17 AM + 129 PM), check avg $26.94. Very quiet morning, no large parties, opener cut early. Quiet happy hour with a pop for dinner from 7 (~8 tables), emptied ~9pm; part of Monday's 30-top returned at 10pm at about half size. Sun Club slow (pop 3-4pm, mostly view-seekers). Kitchen steady, slowed toward end; Isaac sent home ~7:30. No 86s. Industry guests incl. Joey from Bellanapoli. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 10/6 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net sales $7,671 vs target $8,000 (-4.1%). Food $1,276. Comps ~$300 (incl. ~$100 shift drinks). 161 guests, check avg $47.65. First Tuesday that felt below full steam on guest volume; bar team strong; phased staff early. Signs trialed in E/W/N alleyways; idea to test LED lighting on NE server station. New items coming this week. Kitchen note: reminder on EON/close-down expectations before BOH clocks out. No 86s, no incidents.
